info.title: Atlas implemented HCM API
info.description: Implemented Core HR/timekeeping subsets, demonstration payroll/accounting and bounded Phase 5 talent workflows; coverage registers retain remaining scope. Server directory/inbox/position search and pagination; legacy employee/request arrays and department/audit reference limits are documented per endpoint. Server-resolved tenant, cookie sessions, CSRF and no-store sensitive responses. Core HR decision replay returns 409; benefits identical decision replay returns its existing result. Stable creation/submission replay returns its existing result.
